title: Lost Mary BM600 Blueberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Blueberry delivers a rich burst of dark, juicy berry flavour with a smooth, rounded finish. The profile leans towards the deeper end of the berry spectrum, offering a bold yet mellow vape that’s consistently sweet without being overpowering. It’s a dependable all-day flavour for fans of classic fruit blends. Each twin pack includes two 2ml prefilled pods containing 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption. Designed exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these pods offer a satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape. Each pod offers up to 600 puffs depending on personal usage. When empty, simply swap in a new pod to continue enjoying your chosen flavour without interruption.
